# V_eta migration coverage ledger

*Generated by `tools/coverage.py` -- do NOT hand-edit; re-run after a schema or migrator change. One row per did_v1 SOURCE class, from BOTH v1 writers: the NDI production templates (read from NDI-matlab `origin/main`, not a lagging feature branch) AND the vhlab app/calculator classes that appear in real corpora but ship no NDI template (footprint = a bespoke migrator that consumes them). Post-v1 DID intermediate classes (zarr, directory, the `*_observation` leaves, ...) are V_eta TARGETS, not v1 sources, and are excluded. Each row shows the V_eta document class(es) the v1 class MIGRATES INTO (from the curated `V_eta_migration_targets.json`), its disposition, and its writer.*

**102 v1 source classes** (91 NDI/main + 11 vhlab app) | by V_eta disposition: consumed by migrator (no tombstone)=27, dissolved → subject=1, in_progress=19, no V_eta home, no migrator -- UNVERIFIED=3, persist=4, retire=45, test/demo fixture (non-production)=3 | 66 have a bespoke migrator.

| `oneepoch` | `oneepoch` | KEEPS ITS CLASS -- a block FOLD, not a dissolution. `oneepoch` is the record of a CONCATENATION (ndi.element.oneepoch glues an element's N epochs into one); its only own field, `epoch_ids`, is the comma-joined list of the sources. Everything else arrives by inheritance from `element_epoch`, which V_eta renames to `acquisition_epoch` -- so no class of that name exists to inherit from and the inherited block would trip the strict top-level check (did2:validation:undeclaredBlock). The migrator moves that block's contents onto the `oneepoch` block and drops the shell. Field-by-field, so an unrecognised v1 field surfaces as undeclaredField rather than riding along unvalidated. ⚠ PASSTHROUGH REPAIR, NOT THE MODEL. Before this the class had NO V_eta schema at all -- coverage.py tagged it non-production, which suppressed the gap -- and a real document quarantined on `No schema file for class "oneepoch"` (measured: DID-matlab scratch probe 8, run 31423494433). The go-forward model is fork A1, chosen by the team 2026-08-10 and recorded in V_eta_epoch_plan.md: the concatenation becomes a typed observation whose `derived_from_#` edges point at the N per-epoch observations, and NO `epoch` entity is minted for the synthetic `whole_session_<ref>` id. That build is gated on the raw-recording plan being signed. NOTE the tombstone declares `clocks`, NOT the did_v1 `epoch_clock`/`t0_t1`: the base element_epoch superclass migrator collapses the pair before validation sees the document, so the did_v1 names never arrive. | retire | ndi |
